evidence.observation: Initial ~762 °C settles smoothly to the 750 °C setpoint by ~t=2700 s; normal control transient
Brief pressure excursion to ~3.2-3.26 Torr for ~60 s (k=114-125), then returned to 3.0 Torr; minor, transient
Cooldown purge ramped to 200 sccm as commanded, P shifted to ~4.0 Torr consistent with higher flow
Heater off, temperature decaying monotonically (~0.45 °C/s) as expected
Exhaust O2 stable 2-7 ppm throughout, no leak signature

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/AFM) of the sample to judge whether the target film grew; also confirmation that the brief 3.2 Torr pressure blip at t≈3065-3125 s was only a gauge/flow transient.
